resources.string: Configure an independent OpenAI Images-compatible connection. The image tool uses only this saved connection, not your chat model or login.
A saved connection is configured for the image tool.
The image tool is unavailable until you save a connection with its own API key and model.
Enter the HTTPS root URL, /v1, or a complete /images/generations URL. HTTP is allowed only for loopback.
Leave blank to keep the key for this address. Changing the address requires entering a key again.
Connection saved. No image was generated.
Could not read the image connection. The image tool will not use an unreadable connection.
Could not save the image connection. Check the address, key and device storage, then try again.
Remove the independent image connection and disable the image tool. This leaves chat settings and generated files unchanged.
Could not remove the image connection. Try again.
The catalog lists no image models. You can enter a model ID below.
Could not load the image catalog. Refresh to retry or enter a model ID below.
To fetch models, enter a valid Images address and a key for that address. You can also enter a model ID below.
